provenance: New source translation; E4710-E4719 and E4800-E4809 reviewed.
context: Beatrix seals the gate with the fiends as an eternal key. Tanya explores small clue box and large trapped treasure chest, then finds her bunny among Heart Bunnies.
decisions: Bug chirping metaphor retained for alarm clue. Choices preserve top/bottom/leave logic. Ritual uses formal diction; Tanya speaks simply. Cross-row sentences retain breaks.

translations.en: and spread through the surroundings in an instant.
Gwaaaaagh! Wh-what is this light...?!
M-my body...?!
Wh-what have you doooooone?!
M-my soul is being sucked away!
S-stop! Please, stooooop!
M-my body... It's merging with the gaaaaate!
Gwaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaagh!
Until now, the otherworldly gate had only radiated an evil aura and admitted monsters.
As the light struck it, it began sucking in the surrounding air instead.
In an instant, it was drawing air in with a deafening roar.
Strangely, only the monsters were pulled in:
not a single hair on your head stirred.
As the master of this statue, I beseech thee!
Close the otherworldly gate! Take these beings as offerings and make them an everlasting key,
that this gate may be locked for all eternity!
The gate slammed shut with a tremendous crash.
The sound of the rushing air ceased,
and utter silence fell.
Is it over?
It's over. All of it...
The song of destruction is over. So is our age of imprisonment under the curse.
Cheers of victory broke the silence and echoed all around.
You found a small treasure chest.
Yet it was really too small to call a treasure chest.
An intricately decorated jewelry box was a better description.
Hurry, open it! I want to see!
Despite @7rTanya's@0r urging, you first examined the box all around.
It did not appear to be locked,
nor did it seem to be trapped.
You took the plunge and lifted the lid,
but found only some words carved inside.
"Enter from above and it explodes. Enter from below and an insect chirps.
If neither appeals, leave it as it is."
What on earth did that mean?
You found a large treasure chest.
It looked very sturdily built.
As you were about to open it,
the message carved in the small box came to mind.
A closer look showed that the box was somewhat unstable in shape,
and could apparently be turned upside down.
Examining it, you discovered
that it was built to open from below as well.
Would opening the lid normally cause an explosion,
while opening it upside down made an insect chirp?
You understood the explosion, but what did the insect mean?
Open it normally
Turn it upside down and open it
Leave the box closed
The moment you opened it, the treasure chest exploded in your hands.
Owww! That huuuurts!
The blast apparently dealt damage over a wide area.
Despite the explosion, the box itself was intact,
and you were able to look inside.
The moment you opened the chest, a shrill alarm rang out.
It would draw every monster in the area.
Was this what the chirping insect meant?!
You decided to leave the box as it was without opening it.
When you opened the chest and peered inside,
you found money and items.
I'll hold on to these.
We'll split them when we get back to the tavern.
This is probably the treasure we're after.
So, let's go back to the tavern.
The treasure chest did not appear to be locked.
Open the treasure chest?
Open it
Leave it closed
Then a piercing noise rang out.
You spotted something fluffy and pink, utterly out of place in a labyrinth,
hopping merrily along.
Ah! It's Bunny!
It's my Bunny!!
It was indeed what had supposedly been @7rTanya's@0r stuffed toy:
the pink bunny. But something was strange.
The bunny turned at @7rTanya's@0r voice.
At that instant, countless Heart Bunnies
appeared around it.
Whaaat?! Are those Bunny's friends?!
Bunny had friends of its own...
